root_cause_label: Successful Implementation Without Final Submission Signal
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly implemented and verified the JS-filtering script but never invoked the required completion/submission tool, causing the benchmark to record a failure.
t_err_evidence: Step 5 is the final step where the agent reads the processed test.html and confirms JS is filtered; at this point the agent should have called the submission tool but instead the trajectory ends with no completion signal.
t_commit_evidence: Once the trajectory ends at step 5 without a completion call, the failing outcome is locked; there are no subsequent steps where recovery is possible.
trigger_explanation: The agent never invoked the OpenHands submission/finish tool after completing the task. It appeared unaware of or neglected the protocol requirement to explicitly signal task completion, which is the sole cause of failure.
